General Clinical Information: The guideline discusses various aspects and methods related to coronary revascularization, including the use of statins, contrast nephropathy, acute kidney injury, and elective surgeries.
Specific focus is given to scenarios such as acute myocardial infarction, non-ST segment elevation myocardial infarction, chronic kidney disease, and mitral valve surgery.
The document also reviews the risks and benefits of percutaneous coronary intervention and coronary artery bypass graft surgery in different patient populations.
